description: ["**/*"] selects all non-hidden project files, including target/ and node_modules/ contents and the root camunda.json (all overridden by the matching wildcard), but no dot-prefixed file and nothing inside a dot-prefixed directory (.git/, .github/). Control files .c8ignore and .process-application are hidden. A nested camunda.json is an ordinary file.
spec: ["**/*"] selects all non-hidden project files, including target/ contents; users wanting a narrower set name resource directories or add exclusions.
